controls.title: Dedicated least-privilege administrators
controls.assertion: Privileged work uses identifiable dedicated admin accounts; routine work and delegated tasks avoid super-admin privilege.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Role roster and task-to-role review covering all administrators.
controls.review_gate: Record the owner of each privileged role; test delegation before removing access.

controls.title: Phishing-resistant admin sign-in
controls.assertion: Administrators use enforced security-key/passkey-capable sign-in with tested spare credentials.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Effective 2SV method policy and successful administrator sign-in tests.
controls.review_gate: Complete enrollment and recovery testing before stricter method enforcement.

controls.title: Independent administrator recovery
controls.assertion: At least two separately accountable super administrators have tested recovery routes and securely stored spare credentials.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Private recovery exercise record, custodians, and dependencies.
controls.review_gate: Do not copy shared emergency-account assumptions from another identity provider.

controls.title: Workforce 2SV enforcement
controls.assertion: Every in-scope workforce account is covered by the approved 2SV policy, with enrollment verified and temporary exceptions recorded.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Effective OU/group policies plus enrollment and real sign-in evidence.
controls.review_gate: Group precedence and report lag can hide gaps; agree onboarding grace and recovery method.

controls.title: Controlled external collaboration
controls.assertion: Confidential firm/deal content is shared only through approved authenticated collaboration scopes; broad external links are restricted.
controls.evidence_to_collect: OU/group settings and allowed/denied sharing tests using synthetic files.
controls.review_gate: Map investor, portfolio, counsel, and administrator collaboration before tightening access.

controls.title: Guest and external permission review
controls.assertion: An owner reviews external people and item permissions; access is removed when the collaboration ends.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Dated permission review and a removal test for shared-drive and individually shared content.
controls.review_gate: Blocking sharing can leave permissions in place; re-enabling can restore access.

controls.title: App access review
controls.assertion: OAuth apps have an approved owner, purpose, data scope, and access decision; unknown high-access apps are investigated.
controls.evidence_to_collect: API controls inventory and review of OAuth scopes and effective access decisions.
controls.review_gate: A trusted publisher or app label does not establish a business need.

controls.title: Narrow domain-wide delegation
controls.assertion: Every domain-wide delegation grant has an essential business case, narrow scopes, controlled credentials, and a review date.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Grant inventory, scope review, service-account ownership and key-management record.
controls.review_gate: Do not grant domain-wide delegation merely to collect this assessment.

controls.title: Managed endpoint requirements
controls.assertion: Device owners have an approved platform-specific enrollment, encryption, screen-lock, supported-OS, and lost-device response standard with evidence of coverage.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Device inventory, management capability map, exception list, and synthetic lost-device tabletop.
controls.review_gate: Basic and advanced management differ; identify a separate endpoint tool where needed.

controls.title: Context-aware access coverage
controls.assertion: Licensed in-scope users accessing selected sensitive apps are covered by tested context-aware access requirements.
controls.evidence_to_collect: License-by-user coverage, access-level assignments, browser/platform and denied-access tests.
controls.review_gate: Unsupported editions do not enforce these policies; service-account/API and app coverage require separate review.

controls.title: SPF sender inventory
controls.assertion: Each sending domain has a validated SPF record covering all authorized senders without duplicate SPF records or invalid lookup expansion.
controls.evidence_to_collect: DNS record and sender inventory, with message-header tests for each sender class.
controls.review_gate: Include investor communications, CRM, finance, ticketing, and marketing before DNS changes.

controls.title: DKIM signing
controls.assertion: All in-scope sending domains and services use validated DKIM signing with documented key ownership.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Published key, enabled signing status, and received-message signature test.
controls.review_gate: Use the actual vendor-generated key/selector; never copy example DNS values.

controls.title: DMARC enforcement plan
controls.assertion: A domain owner has validated alignment and reporting, completed sender remediation, and approved an enforced DMARC policy for in-scope domains.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Policy record, representative aligned headers, report review and change approval.
controls.review_gate: Monitoring-only is a rollout stage; move toward enforcement after legitimate traffic is understood.

controls.title: Audit coverage and retention
controls.assertion: Required audit sources, lag, retention, export path, access owners, and retrieval tests are documented for the actual edition.
controls.evidence_to_collect: A source-by-source matrix and successful retrieval of a synthetic event.
controls.review_gate: Native log windows vary; export before expiry if the approved need is longer.

controls.title: Actionable admin alerts
controls.assertion: Administrative/security alert types have an owner, escalation route, and a completed delivery-and-response test.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Alert routing settings and dated response exercise.
controls.review_gate: Verify the route remains reachable during primary account or mail-service failure.

controls.title: Reviewed retention and holds
controls.assertion: A records owner has approved data-type retention and hold requirements, and verified effective Vault coverage or a documented alternative.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Approved schedule, licensed population, rules/hold review and scoped retrieval test.
controls.review_gate: Vault needs applicable licenses and configured rules; deletion/license removal can affect retained data.

controls.title: Tested business recovery
controls.assertion: Critical mail and document workloads have agreed recovery objectives, a coverage map, and a restore exercise that verifies content and permissions.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Recovery method per workload, measured restore result, missing-data/permission findings.
controls.review_gate: Native recovery windows and Vault exports do not establish end-to-end business recovery.

controls.title: Controlled identity rollout
controls.assertion: Identity and access changes have a pilot, enrollment check, business tests, recovery route, and saved previous configuration.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Approved change record and pilot test results.
controls.review_gate: Use actual product capabilities; do not assume every Google setting has report-only mode.

controls.title: Durable document ownership
controls.assertion: Critical operating records use accountable shared ownership with reviewed membership and continuity when a staff member leaves.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Critical repository map and ownership/permission continuity test.
controls.review_gate: Shared-drive availability and supported behavior depend on edition and chosen structure.

controls.title: Offboarding access and records
controls.assertion: A tested leaver process suspends relevant access, addresses delegated/third-party access, and preserves records under the approved schedule.
controls.evidence_to_collect: Synthetic leaver exercise with identity, applications, ownership, retention, and verification checkpoints.
controls.review_gate: Suspension is one step; do not equate account deletion with a complete leaver process.
